name: textarea-master-claude
description: A minimalist text editor that lives in your browser, with local file open, multi-format and QR export, a local document library and AES-256 encrypted links and archives.

scripts.check: npm run lint && find app.js lib tests -name '*.js' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check
scripts.test:browsers: BROWSER=firefox npm run test:browser && BROWSER=webkit npm run test:browser
scripts.test:all: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:browser
